## DISCLOSURES

| Speaker              | Details                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Chappell, Kathy      | am a member of an advisory board for Pfizer and Merck. receive no honoraria: Travel costs are reimbursed to                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Gordon, Jennifer     | am a member of a global educational advisory board for Pfizer and Merck-Sorono.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Grad, Roland         | received honoraria from the International Centre for Evidence Based Medicine for two online modules.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Lalla, Leonora       | have received dividends as a minor shareholder in a medical clinic in Pierrefonds, Quebec.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Outschoorn; Amy      | have received compensation from industry for travel expenses only; for sitting on a board of directors for Food Allergy Canada and the Canadian Premature Babies Foundation.                                                                                                                          |
| Smith, Karen         | have received or will be receiving a grant or honorarium from Shire Pharmaceuticals for contributing to an investigator initiated research grant. The Queen's CPD department has received payment from commercial organizations in support of programming: Ido not receive personal support or gifts: |
| Sockalingam; Sanjeev | have received or will be receiving a grant or honorarium from Shire Pharmaceuticals for contributing to an investigator initiated research grant:.                                                                                                                                                    |
| Switzer; Connie      | am a member of an advisory board for Abbvie and Merck.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
